about: What the drones say, in System Latin (see data/system_latin/system_latin_systemized.md), said as beeps, hums and buzzes - see src/formants/chirps.rs - so that no one hears it as speech; 'means' is what it says in English. 'lines' are by the animation a drone says them as it starts: one of them, picked in turn, each time it starts that animation; an animation with none, or not given, is done in silence.
